The statement rules naming these values restate them: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR33 ('22'/'24' on relative WRITE), §2023:14.9.35.4 GR21 ('23' on REWRITE). 23 c)-d) cover START key length and sequential files only, so no conforming 1985 relative program changes.
